description: This file contains the PHP class 'Api' within the 'Opencart\Catalog\Model\Account' namespace. The class provides methods for API login, session management, and IP retrieval related to the account functionalities in the OpenCart system.

classes.name: Api
classes.description: A class providing API authentication and session management methods for account-related features.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Authenticates a user with username and key, returning the database row if successful.

methods.name: addSession
methods.description: Creates a new API session record with session ID and IP address, returning the new session ID.

methods.name: getIps
methods.description: Retrieves all IP addresses associated with a specific API ID.
